system.description:
"What the hell do you think you're looking at?! Unless you want your eye ball plucked out and your eye sockets filled with roaches and sown shut, I'd suggest looking elsewhere!" Those were the vulgar remarks shouted at me by a child no older than 11 years. Her mother didn't even bat an eye. There is something deeply wrong with the members of this clan.

- Saikusu Uchiha

At Worlds End, Ch. 19 excerpt.

If Music be the Song of Death

The Kashu Clan are a clan of foul mouthed, aggressive, masters of genjutsu. The clan has contracts with unknown evils from different realms to preform malicious jutsu and summoning horrid creatures. Not much is known about the clan other than their clear affiliation with the land of sound and their superior auditory genjutsu.

Kashu Traits

Tag: Canon Inspired, Creator: StruggledKing

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Survival

Illusory Genius: You reduce downtime cost to learn Genjutsu you qualify for by an amount equal to their rank, to a minimum of 1. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)

Hijutsu Flexibility: Kashu Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Kashu Sound Techniques: The Kashu Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Bound Instruments: Select one Simple Weapon or a Weapon you are proficient in. You use techniques taught by your clan to reengineer it to double as a Shinobi Instrument. A special weapon usable only by your clan that doubles as a musical instrument.

Branch Family: The Kashu are split between three different branches, the [Harmonic Branch], the [Symphonic Branch] and the [Mnemonic Branch]. The Harmonic branch are bards and composers who utilize shinobi tools disguised as instruments such as bladed flutes or poisoned harmonicas, and infuse Genjutsu into their songs. The Symphonic branch are tinkerers that infuse shinobi tech into their instruments, turning them into sound-based weapons, such as tuning gauntlets or ultrasonic Boom whackers, focusing on a more martial centric fighting style. The Mnemonic branch specialize in traps and tricks and prefers wire-based instruments such as guitars, violins and lutes, whose wires can be used to set said traps. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later

Kashu Features

Conductors Throne

1st Level Clan Feature, [Harmonic Branch]

This branch of Kashu, tend to think of themselves as puppeteers, composers or even conductors of battle. This doesn’t come from Hubris, no. Instead, this comes from one of the clans core secret techniques. A special summoned creature, known as the Doki. Unlike other summoned creatures, the Doki are bound not by an elaborate contract, but instead, to the melodies you play and they are summoned the same way. Your Shinobi Instrument is their leash, and you use the music it produces to command them.

You gain access to one of three Doki’s. The Bandaged, The Claw, or the Club. You gain access to one of the remaining Doki’s at 7th and 15th levels. When initiative is rolled, you can choose to roll your initiative at disadvantage. If you do, you summon all of your Doki’s as part of rolling initiative otherwise, you can summon them one at a time as a Bonus action. They are summoned into a space that can hold them within 30 feet of you. Your Doki’s act as a bonus action on your turn, commanding all active Doki’s at once as part of the same bonus action. Your Doki’s remain until dismissed, they are reduced to 0 hit points or you are incapacitated, at which point they are dispelled. Once dismissed or defeated, a Doki cannot be resummoned until you spend at least 10 minutes meditating outside of combat.

Beginning at 11th level, you can command one Doki to at no action cost, on your turn. The remaining Doki can be commanded to move, but not use any ability, jutsu or attack it has, if commanded this way.

Resonance Crown

1st Level Clan Feature, [Symphonic Branch]

This branch of Kashu, focus more on the technological side of their craft, modifying their Shinobi Instrument in ways to augment their combat capabilities. This branch focuses on putting pressure on your foes through brutal close or mid-range combat. Your Shinobi Instrument enables you to fight far above your weight class.

Rather than a combat stance, when initiative is rolled, you tune your Shinobi Instrument to build Resonance. Resonance is represented as vibrational buildup your Shinobi Instrument has accumulated from your attacks. You begin combat with 0 Resonance, and can gain 1 Resonance, per turn, when you make an attack with your Shinobi Instrument or a Taijutsu (or Bukijutsu) while wielding your Shinobi Instrument. Your Shinobi Instrument can store up to 4 Resonance. You can only gain Resonance in combat. Resonance last for 1 minute or until your release a Menacing Melody or Combat ends. You begin with 3 such Melodies. If a Melody requires a saving throw it uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Vertigo Strike. Once per turn, when you deal damage with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 1 Resonance, to force the target creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Disorientation.

Frenetic Frequency. When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a Melee attack while you are wielding your Shinobi Instrument, you can, as a reaction spend 2 Resonance, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they take 2d8 psychic damage, and gain 2 ranks of Concussed. This increases by +2d8 at 7th and 15th levels.

Overtone Burst. Once per turn, when you deal damage as a result of a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you cast with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 2 Resonance to either reduce the targets DR by 4 or remove one of the following resistances (Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Earth, Lighting, Psychic, or Force), until the end of your next turn.

Bell Witch

1st Level Clan Feature, [Mnemonic Branch]

This branch of Kashu, focus more on the ancient art of traps and acoustics to overwhelm their enemies senses. Your Shinobi Instrument enables you to fight without your enemies even realizing they are at a disadvantage.

When facing you a trap is always waiting to be sprung. You use your Shinobi Instrument to set up a network of bells and sonic strings that turn the battlefield into your own killing choir.

Once per turn, while in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns you can place a Bell Wire at and point you can see within 30 feet. A Bell Wire is an invisible tripwire of sonic chakra that occupies a 10-foot radius centered on this chosen point. You can maintain up to 6 Bell Wires at a time. A Bell Wire is triggered when a hostile creatures moves through the radius. Placing additional Bell Wires beyond your maximum dismisses the oldest one.

When a creature triggers a Bell Wire, you can spend your reaction to cast any Kashu Hijutsu with the Auditory keyword targeting the triggering creature and dispel the placed Bell Wire. The jutsu originates from the triggered Bell Wire location. You do not need line of sight to the triggering creature. You are always aware if a hostile creature would trigger your Bell Wire.

Harmonic Songs

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Harmonic Branch]

You have developed an album of songs meant to bring ruin to your foes, but victory to you and your allies. These songs are known as your Harmonies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Harmonies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.

If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.

Pull The Strings

Once per turn, when a Kashu clan Hijutsu you cast would affect a creature with ranks of a Mental Condition, on a failure, they become overwhelmed with a strong drive to approach the source of your song, even if detrimental. They spend their reaction to move up to their speed towards you. This movement can trigger attacks of opportunity.

Binding Melody

Doki you control gain the Binding Melody ability.

Binding Melody. While mute, this Doki begins to jump, bounce and move in a rhythmic fashion. All hostile creatures within 10 feet of the Doki must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they suffer the curse of Binding, gaining 1 rank of Sealed, and being unable to target creatures other this Doki until the end of their next turn. Ranks of Sealed increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Rhythmic Repeat

Once per turn, when a creature with ranks of Disorientation takes damage from a source other than you or a Doki you control, you deal an additional 1d6 psychic damage to them, per rank of Disorientation, as their ear drums vibrates violently in response. This is treated as conditional damage.

Echo Chamber

When you cast a Kashu clan Hijutsu, you can have it originate from up to two active Doki you have instead of yourself. If you do, creatures can only be affected by one instance of the chosen jutsu at once.

Aggressive Tempo

When you cast a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, if an allied creature is in the jutsu’s range, they become immune to its hostile effects, and also gain a +10 bonus to their speed, and a +2 bonus to damage they deal as a result of jutsu they cast until the end of their next turn. Their bonus to speed increases to +20 at 7th and +30 at 15th levels. And their bonus to damage increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th levels.

Underworlds Melody

As an Action, you release a regenerative song, healing all Doki within 15 feet of you by 4d6 hit points. This increases to 6d6 at 7th and 8d6 at 15th levels. Doki can only be affected by this song, twice per combat.

Demonic Chorus

Kashu Genjutsu you cast, increase their damage by +2 for every active Doki you have as their overlapping demonic resonance amplifies your illusory output.

Harmonious Bridge

Once per turn, when a Doki scores a hit on a creature, you can immediately command it or another Doki to use their Revolt of the Demon World attack against the same creature.

Symphonic Songs

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Symphonic Branch]

You have developed an album of songs meant to raise your tempo and stop the flow of your enemies. These songs are known as your Symphonies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Symphonies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.

If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.

Staccato Burst

Once per turn, when you spend Resonance, you can choose to release the stored vibrational energy in a sudden burst. All hostile creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d6 psychic damage for each Resonance spent.

Dissonant Chord

You gain the Dissonant Chord Melody that you can spend Resonance on.

Dissonant Chord. Once per turn, when you score a hit and deal either [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 1 Resonance to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose concentration on 1 random jutsu they are concentrating on.

Subsonic Pressure

Once per turn, when you use the Overturn Burst Melody, if the target has ranks of Disorientation, the DR penalty or Resistance suppression lasts until they have no ranks of Disorientation.

Overtuned Frequency.

As a Bonus action, you concentrate on over tuning your Shinobi Instrument. Your Shinobi Instrument can hold up to 8 Resonance, and you can gain up to 2 Resonance per trigger, per turn, but you must concentrate on doing so as if you are concentrating on an A-Rank Genjutsu.

Sonic Cannon

You tweak your Shinobi Instrument, to allow you to release blasts of sound and wind, gaining the Sonic Cannon and Sonic Cannon Burst attacks.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Sonic Cannon attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Sonic Cannon attacks instead of one.

Sonic Cannon. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 1d12 force damage. If you roll a 10 or higher on the damage die, the target gains 1 rank of Disorientation. This attack counts as using your Shinobi Instrument for features that call for it.

Sonic Cannon Burst. As an Action, you spend all remaining Resonance, releasing it as an overwhelming shockwave, forcing all creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 1d12 force damage for every Resonance spent, or half as much damage on a successful save.

Piercing Tone

[Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] you deal with your Shinobi Instrument ignores resistance and treats Immunity as resistance while you have at least 4 Resonance.

Resonant Disruption

Your Shinobi Instrument acts as a passive shield against sound. When you would make a saving throw to resist the effects of a Genjutsu cast against you with the Auditory keyword, your Shinobi Instrument automatically spends 1 Resonance, to grant you advantage on this save.

Additionally, if you succeed, you treat your success as if you critically succeeded instead, if possible.

Subsonic Grip

You gain the Subsonic Grip Melody that you can spend Resonance on.

Subsonic Grip. Once per turn, when you deal damage with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 2 Resonance, to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you vibrate the fluid in their joints until movement becomes agonizing. They become Restrained in place until the end of their next turn.

Mnemonic Songs

3rd Level Clan Feature, [Mnemonic Branch]

You have developed an album of songs meant to bring ruin to your foes, but victory to you and your allies. These songs are known as your Mnemodies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Mnemodies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.

If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.

Haunting Notes

You gain the Haunting Note attack. Also, when a creature triggers one of your Bell Wires, you can choose to instead make a Haunting Note attack at no additional action, instead of spending your Reaction.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Haunting Note attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Haunting Note attacks instead of one.

Haunting Note. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you or an active Bell Wire. On a hit, you deal 1d8 psychic damage. If a target already has at least 1 rank of Disorientation, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain ranks of Dazzled equal to their ranks of Disorientation.

Multi-Traps

You can place 2 Bell Wires as a Bonus action on your turn. They must be in different locations and their areas cannot overlap.

Hair Trigger

Bell Wires you place, now trigger on any movement through their space, including forced movement.

I Planned For This

When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a melee attack, you can spend your reaction to dispel an active Bell Wire. If you do, Select one Kashu Clan Hijutsu you know of D-Rank that forces a saving throw and cast it as part of this reaction, at no chakra cost targeting them.

The rank of jutsu you can cast increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.

Taut String

Once per turn, when a creature within 30 feet of a Bell Wire casts a jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) component, you can spend your reaction to Dispel that Bell Wire. When you do, the triggering creature must make a Wisdom saving throw as they begin to hear music from all directions. On a failure, they become Confused for the next minute. A creature Confused in this way remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the Confused condition on a success.

Cruel Reverb

When a creature triggers a Bell Wire, you can choose to instead have the triggering creature make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Berserk for the next minute. A creature that is Berserk in this way ends this condition the first time they deal damage to a creature they previously considered an ally.

Patient Trap

You can now place Bell Wires outside of combat. Bell Wires placed in this way persist for up to 24 hours before fading.

Bell Wires placed this way are always delayed and do not trigger automatically. They always alert you to a creature crossing its affected area. If combat would begin and a creature is standing in your Bell Wires affected area, they automatically trigger, forcing them to make their Initiative roll at disadvantage, and you can use your triggered Bell Wires effects as part of initiative being rolled. You can maintain up to 4 Bell Wires outside of combat.

Lingering Bell

When a Bell Wire is triggered, you can choose to instead mark them as a Lingering Bell. A creature marked as a Lingering Bell remains marked for up to 1 minute. You can spend your Bonus action on your turn or Reaction on other creatures turn to detonate a Lingering Bell. Once detonated, all creatures within 20-feet of a Lingering Bell must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become Slowed and gain 1 rank of Concussed.

Increase the ranks of Concussed by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

The target creature is the only creature they can target with attacks, jutsu or effects that requires them to select a creature to harm. / A creature with 5 or more ranks of Disoriented cannot make attacks as they cannot reliably target creatures. / Creatures that are immune to psychic damage or the Dazzled condition is immune to this condition. / A Disoriented creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Wisdom ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

7th Level Clan Feature

The Kashu clan's mastery of sound extends beyond the battlefield. By performing on your Shinobi Instrument for at least 10 minutes, creatures that can hear you, you weave a subtle emotional undercurrent into your music. For the next 24 hours, the first time you or an allied creature socially interacts with a creature that heard your song, the initiating creature gains a +4 bonus to any Charisma based check made. If you or an allied creature attempts a Charisma Skill based action during this time against a creature that heard your song, they make any contested check or saving throw to resist or otherwise at disadvantage. Once a creature is affected by your song in this way, they become immune to its effects until they complete a Full-Rest.

Additionally, as part of this performance, if you are inside a building, you saturate the area with lingering frequencies. You learn the exact structural layout of the building you occupy within a 120-foot radius, penetrating through walls, and barriers that aren’t chakra enhanced. This does not reveal creatures, only the structural layout, possibly revealing hidden rooms or trap doors.

Killing Frequency

11th Level Clan Feature

The Kashu clan's most technically demanding technique is not a jutsu. It is a piece of music. A sustained composition played at a frequency so precisely calibrated to a living creature's biological and chakra resonance that it turns their own body into a weapon against them.

As an Action, you can begin to play your Shinobi Instrument, creating your Killing Frequency. Your Killing Frequency is a sustained state that lasts for up to 1 minute. Your Killing Frequency fills a radius based on the source you choose for its duration;

30-foot radius centered on you, and moves with you.

20-foot radius centered on one of your Doki. You can switch which Doki the Killing Frequency is centered on at the beginning of each of your turns.

10-foot radius centered on all active Bell Wires.

While your Killing Frequency is up, you gain the following abilities: Effects that trigger when a hostile creature performs an action such as cast a jutsu or move can only be used once per turn. They cannot all be used at the same time and once an effect has been used it cannot be used until the next creatures turn. Once you activate your Killing Frequency feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

Embedded Frequency. Twice per turn, hostile creatures that cast a Jutsu with the Hand Seal (HS) or Mobility (M) components within your Killing Frequency, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they gain a rank of Disoriented.

Chakra Interference. Once per turn, when a hostile creature attempts to cast a jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component within your Killing Frequency, they must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they increase the cost of the jutsu cast by +8.

Sonic Pulse. Once per turn, when a hostile creature with ranks of Disoriented moves more than 10 feet within your Killing Frequency on their turn, they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take 2d6 psychic damage, for each rank of Disoriented they have.

Discordant Broadcast. Once per turn, when a hostile creature begins their turn maintaining concentrating on a jutsu or effect within your Killing Frequency they must make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they must choose to either triple their concentration chakra cost (if any) or lose concentration.

Opus

15th Level Clan Feature

Every great composer eventually transcends the boundaries of their chosen instrument and sound. The Kashu clans mastery of sound does not end at the edge of their Branches techniques. It only expands and grows, hungrily consuming the methods of their sister branches. Select one of your sister branches. You gain access to that branches 1st and 3rd level features and can now learn jutsu with the associated branch keywords with the following limitations:

Harmonic Branch: You gain one Doki of your choice. You can summon it following the rules of the Conductors Throne clan feature. You can command it, once per turn as at no action cost. Your Doki acts on your turn. You also gain 2 Harmonies from the Harmonic Songs clan feature. These two Harmonies are always prepared for you.

Symphonic Branch: Your Shinobi Instrument can begin to store up to 2 Resonance, and can use all three Melodies in the same way that the Resonance Crown clan feature dictates. You also gain 2 Harmonies from the Symphonic Songs clan feature. These two Symphonies are always prepared for you.

Mnemonic Branch: You learn to place Bell Wires following the rules of the Bell Witch clan feature. You can maintain up to 3 Bell Wires simultaneously and place one per turn at the start of your turn as described in the Bell Witch clan feature. You also gain 2 Mnemodies from the Mnemonic Songs clan feature. These two Mnemodies are always prepared for you.
